mutation_targets.rationale: If every task must have a creator from the User set, removing this fact allows Alloy to construct Tasks with no creator (since created_by is lone, not one). Both assertions check that creators exist and are Users.
If every task must have exactly one creator, removing this fact allows Tasks to have zero creators. The OwnershipExclusivity assertion directly enforces one-to-one creator relationship.
If every TaskDeletion record must have a deleter, removing this fact allows deletions with no associated user. AppendOnly checks that all deletion records are attributed to a User.

If all task titles must be valid (in ValidTitle), removing this fact allows invalid titles to exist. FR_005_TitleConstraint requires that at least one task has a valid title, which fails when all titles can be invalid.
If assigned tasks must assign to existing members, removing this fact allows non-member assignees. FR_008_AssigneeIsMember checks that all assignees belong to the User set.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: some t: Task | (some t.assignee and t.assignee !in User)

mutation_targets.rationale: If all task descriptions must be valid (in ValidDescription), removing this fact allows invalid descriptions. FR_006_DescriptionLength requires that at least one task has a valid description.
